label: Mining speed
description: Always increases correct-tool mining speed.
review: Fourfold strength; assembled head quality also grants an innate mining multiplier. A speed investment improves an already enchanted tool.

label: Fortune
description: Adds stochastically rounded native Fortune levels, combined cap X.
review: 2.5x strength and combined Fortune up to X; vanilla Fortune III no longer makes this roll redundant.

label: Magnetized
description: Pulls only your freshly mined drops toward you, never thrown items.
review: Twice the attraction range with a 24-block cap; preserves ownership and full-inventory rules.

label: Silk touch
description: Chance to generate native Silk Touch loot; exclusive with the base Fortune and Smelter families.
review: Twice the chance; strong rolls reliably provide Silk Touch without occupying an enchantment.

label: Reinforced
description: Increases maximum durability on any reconstructed tool.
review: Triple the bonus with a much higher cap to support meaningful bulk excavation.

label: Scholar
description: Increases block and furnace experience; suppressed by Silk Touch.
review: Triple mining XP strength and a larger combined XP cap.

label: Aquatic
description: Recovers a fraction of the underwater mining penalty.
review: Triple penalty recovery; mid-to-high rolls can eliminate the underwater penalty.

label: Steady hands
description: Recovers a fraction of the airborne mining penalty.
review: Triple penalty recovery so airborne excavation is practical.

label: Long reach
description: Adds native block interaction range in the main hand.
review: Triple added reach, capped at six extra blocks; native interaction checks still apply.

label: Smelter
description: Chance to apply the real furnace recipe to each drop, preserving recipe counts and XP.
review: Twice the recipe-processing chance; high rolls reach reliable furnace-free processing.

label: Phasebound
description: Chance to put final mined drops directly into your inventory; overflow remains in the world.
review: Fourfold collection chance; strong rolls reliably collect loot directly into inventory.

label: Hardwearing
description: Chance to prevent each durability point before native Unbreaking.
review: 2.5x preservation chance, capped at 95%, stacking with native Unbreaking.

label: Deep reserves
description: Adds flat maximum durability, after the Reinforced multiplier.
review: Fivefold flat durability; the result is a meaningful buffer for area mining.

label: Self repair
description: Repairs this held tool every five seconds.
review: Tenfold repair amount and a five-second interval, making a self-sustaining utility component viable.

label: Mending affinity
description: Repairs extra durability on XP pickup without consuming additional player XP.
review: Fourfold repair per XP and compatibility with Knowledge Siphon; useful with or without vanilla Mending.

label: Frugal repairs
description: Reduces anvil level and material costs on nonempty repairs; costs never fall below one.
review: Double the discount, capped at 85%; nonempty repairs still cost at least one level and one material.

label: Nugget maintenance
description: While crouching, consumes an iron nugget every five seconds to repair durability.
review: Twentyfold repair per iron nugget and a five-second interval; paid maintenance should be substantial.

label: Rain tempered
description: Repairs every five seconds while exposed to rain or submerged.
review: Tenfold free repair and a five-second interval; environmental specialization has a clear payoff.

label: Lightweight grip
description: Adds main-hand movement speed as a fraction of base speed.
review: Triple movement bonus, still active only while the tool is held in the main hand.

label: Braced grip
description: Adds main-hand knockback resistance.
review: Triple resistance with a 90% cap; useful protection while excavating near enemies.

label: Guarded grip
description: Adds main-hand armor points.
review: Triple flat armor with a sixteen-point cap; a dedicated grip is meaningful protection.

label: Vital grip
description: Adds main-hand maximum health points; two points equal one heart.
review: Fourfold flat health with a twenty-point cap; two health points remain one heart.

label: Stonecutter
description: Increases mining speed while common stone.
review: Triple the conditional stone bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Ore runner
description: Increases mining speed while ores.
review: Triple the conditional ore bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Sediment cutter
description: Increases mining speed while sand, gravel, clay or dirt.
review: Triple the conditional sediment bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Deep delver
description: Increases mining speed while blocks below Y=0.
review: Triple the conditional deep mining bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Sunstruck
description: Increases mining speed while daylight with open sky.
review: Triple the conditional open-sky bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Night shift
description: Increases mining speed in low ambient light (below eight), including dark caves.
review: Triple the conditional darkness bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Water cooled
description: Increases mining speed while rain or water.
review: Triple the conditional wet bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Heat tempered
description: Increases mining speed while the Nether or within two blocks of lava.
review: Triple the conditional hot bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Planted stance
description: Increases mining speed while standing still.
review: Triple the conditional stationary bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Mining rhythm
description: Increases mining speed while up to five consecutive breaks less than three seconds apart.
review: Triple the conditional rhythm bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Varied strata
description: Increases mining speed while switching to a different block within three seconds.
review: Triple the conditional mixed strata bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Last legs
description: Increases mining speed while less than 25% durability remaining.
review: Fivefold low-durability speed for a strong, deliberate risk/reward build.

label: Calibrated edge
description: Increases mining speed while more than 75% durability remaining.
review: Triple the conditional well-maintained bonus; a focused play style should beat a generic speed investment when its condition applies.

label: Prospector
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on any ore; combined Fortune is capped at X.
review: Triple specialist Fortune and a combined Fortune X limit; it stacks usefully above vanilla Fortune III.

label: Gem cutter
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on diamond, emerald or lapis ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.
review: Triple specialist Fortune and a combined Fortune X limit; it stacks usefully above vanilla Fortune III.

label: Redstone savant
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on redstone ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.
review: Triple specialist Fortune and a combined Fortune X limit; it stacks usefully above vanilla Fortune III.

label: Coal splitter
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on coal ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.
review: Triple specialist Fortune and a combined Fortune X limit; it stacks usefully above vanilla Fortune III.

label: Metal splitter
description: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on iron, copper or gold ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.
review: Triple specialist Fortune and a combined Fortune X limit; it stacks usefully above vanilla Fortune III.

label: Deep knowledge
description: Additional mining XP below Y=0.
review: Triple conditional XP; preserves distinct location, target or rhythm requirements.

label: Ore knowledge
description: Additional mining XP on ores.
review: Triple conditional XP; preserves distinct location, target or rhythm requirements.

label: Experienced rhythm
description: Additional mining XP during a consecutive mining chain.
review: Triple conditional XP; preserves distinct location, target or rhythm requirements.

label: Experience condenser
description: Banks half of primary mining XP. Every few breaks releases the bank with a bonus multiplier and resonance. Silk Touch disables this effect.
review: Banked XP now returns with a 1.5x–3x multiplier and resonance, instead of merely delaying the same XP.

label: Echoing spoils
description: Copies the first final drop stack, up to sixteen items per extra copy. Values above 100% can grant multiple extra copies. Disabled by Silk Touch, block entities and secondary breaks.
review: Eightfold proc strength, stochastic extra copies above 100%, and a sixteen-item limit per copy.

label: Gem echo
description: Adds matching diamond, emerald or lapis after a primary gem ore break. The amount increases with ascension. Disabled by Silk Touch.
review: Fourfold chance, up to eight extra gems, and a two-second cooldown.

label: Lucky edge
description: Repairs twelve durability on a successful primary ore proc. Disabled by Silk Touch.
review: Triple chance and twelve durability restored per successful ore proc.

label: Gravel sifter
description: Chance: Converts a gravel drop into flint. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.
review: Triple conversion chance; conversion also works on secondary blocks so area-mining combinations process consistently.

label: Vitrifier
description: Chance: Converts sand drops into glass. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.
review: Triple conversion chance; conversion also works on secondary blocks so area-mining combinations process consistently.

label: Clay kiln
description: Chance: Converts clay balls into bricks. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.
review: Triple conversion chance; conversion also works on secondary blocks so area-mining combinations process consistently.

label: Stone smoother
description: Chance: Converts cobblestone into stone. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.
review: Triple conversion chance; conversion also works on secondary blocks so area-mining combinations process consistently.

label: Slate polisher
description: Chance: Converts cobbled deepslate into polished deepslate. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.
review: Triple conversion chance; conversion also works on secondary blocks so area-mining combinations process consistently.

label: Metal filings
description: Chance: Adds bonus iron or gold nuggets after mining the corresponding ore. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.
review: Fourfold proc chance with a substantial multi-item bonus, instead of a tiny single-item reward.

label: Fossil dust
description: Chance: Adds bonus bone meal when mining calcite or tuff. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.
review: Fourfold proc chance with a substantial multi-item bonus, instead of a tiny single-item reward.

label: Web salvage
description: Chance: Adds bonus string when cutting cobweb. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.
review: Fourfold proc chance with a substantial multi-item bonus, instead of a tiny single-item reward.

label: Prismatic salvage
description: Chance: Adds bonus amethyst shards when breaking an amethyst cluster. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.
review: Fourfold proc chance with a substantial multi-item bonus, instead of a tiny single-item reward.

label: Moss salvage
description: Chance: Adds bone meal when mining moss. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.
review: Fourfold proc chance with a substantial multi-item bonus, instead of a tiny single-item reward.

label: Vein miner
description: Crouch mining excavates connected same-type ores. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Eight to forty-eight extra connected ores rather than two to eight.

label: Tunneler
description: Crouch mining excavates a straight bore behind the target. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: A two-to-eight-block bore, with explicit crouch activation and adequate bounded range.

label: Broadhead
description: Crouch mining excavates a full 3x3 plane, then two layers, a 5x5 plane and finally two 5x5 layers. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Starts at a full 3x3 plane; later stages expand to a 5x5, two-layer excavation.

label: Stairmaker
description: Crouch mining excavates a two-block-high descending passage. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Clears a two-block-high descending passage instead of isolated staircase cells.

label: Surface scraper
description: Crouch mining excavates nearby matching sediment. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Eight to forty-eight matching nearby sediment blocks per activation.

label: Gravel vacuum
description: Crouch mining excavates the sand or gravel column above the target. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Clears eight to thirty-two falling blocks above the target.

label: Branching veins
description: Crouch mining excavates connected ores of mixed types. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Four to thirty-two connected ores, including mixed ore types.

label: Crystal sweep
description: Crouch mining excavates nearby mature amethyst clusters, preserving budding amethyst. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Harvests four to twenty-four nearby mature clusters without targeting budding amethyst.

label: Obsidian chisel
description: Crouch mining excavates nearby matching obsidian. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.
review: Four to thirty-two obsidian blocks per activation, making obsidian specialization valuable.

label: Support mason
description: Places inventory cobblestone below the mined cell when it is unsupported. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.
review: Short one-second-to-one-tenth-second cooldown for reliable support placement.

label: Lightbearer
description: Places an inventory torch in the mined cell when light is low. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.
review: Short cooldown permits consistent tunnel lighting rather than occasional torches.

label: Lava cork
description: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed lava cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.
review: Quick inventory-backed lava sealing; cancellation never consumes material.

label: Water cork
description: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed water cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.
review: Quick inventory-backed water sealing; cancellation never consumes material.

label: Bridgework
description: While crouching, places inventory cobblestone directly beneath your feet. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.
review: Quick crouch-enabled support placement makes traversal practical.

label: Green thumb
description: Consumes bone meal to turn nearby exposed dirt into grass, never replacing other blocks. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.
review: Quick dirt restoration; conservation can save bone meal.

label: Night sight
description: Grants long Night Vision on a primary break. Frequent refresh avoids the short-duration flicker.
review: Twenty-to-sixty-second vision with a five-second cooldown avoids constant expiry and flicker.

label: Prospector sprint
description: Grants Speed after a primary ore break; later stages improve duration and amplifier.
review: Eight-to-twenty-second Speed I/II with much better uptime.

label: Stone skin
description: Grants Resistance after primary stone mining; later stages improve duration and amplifier.
review: Six-to-twelve-second Resistance I/II with a five-second cooldown.

label: Fire ward
description: Grants Fire Resistance after a primary break near lava or while burning.
review: Ten-to-forty-five-second fire resistance instead of three seconds out of ten.

label: Gem ward
description: Grants and recharges temporary absorption hearts after a primary gem ore break. Two health points equal one heart.
review: Two-to-eight absorption hearts for ten-to-thirty seconds, recharging on a ten-second cooldown.

label: Soft landing
description: Grants Slow Falling after an airborne primary break.
review: Eight-to-twenty-four seconds of Slow Falling for useful airborne safety.

label: Echo chamber
description: Slows nearby hostile mobs after an ore break; never targets players or animals.
review: A larger, frequent Slowness II–V pulse; never targets players or passive mobs.

label: Quarry mark
description: Makes nearby hostile mobs glow after an ore break.
review: Marks enemies up to twelve blocks away for ten-to-thirty seconds.

label: Desperate pulse
description: Below half health, a primary break knocks nearby enemies away and heals you. Does not target players or passive mobs.
review: Triggers below half health, knocks back enemies and heals two-to-eight health, with a ten-second cooldown.

label: Air pockets
description: Restores air ticks on underwater primary breaks.
review: Fourfold air restoration makes repeated underwater mining sustainable.

label: Miner sustenance
description: Restores food points and saturation after primary mining when hungry. The chance is quality-adjusted.
review: Fourfold chance, two-to-six food points with saturation, and a four-second cooldown.

label: Recoil step
description: Right-click air to blink backward. Only loaded, dry, collision-free destinations with a solid floor are valid. No automatic movement while mining.
review: An intentional right-click backward blink with a two-second cooldown; no unwanted automatic teleport during mining.

label: Resonant battery
description: Generates additional resonance on primary breaks. All reconstructed pickaxes also have a quality-scaled resonant core. Total capacity: 200.
review: Fourfold generation on top of an innate resonant core, enabling multiple consumers.

label: Overcharge
description: Spends resonance after primary mining for Haste. Milestones improve duration and amplifier.
review: Haste I–III for five-to-fifteen seconds; cheaper cost and a three-second cooldown.

label: Gem battery
description: Generates extra resonance on gem ore breaks.
review: Triple generation for gem-focused builds.

label: Kinetic battery
description: Moving at least one block while holding the tool generates resonance at most once per second. Milestones increase the amount.
review: Three-to-twelve resonance per movement pulse, at most once per second.

label: Experience battery
description: Trades one current primary mining XP for resonance. Does not consume existing player XP or generate XP.
review: One current mining XP buys four-to-sixteen resonance, preserving the explicit XP trade.

label: Quarry discharge
description: Spends resonance to mine an expanding horizontal cross around a primary break. Crouch to enable; shares the total area budget.
review: Four-to-twenty-four extra blocks, cheaper activation, no artificial cooldown, and an innate charge source.

label: Spoils discharge
description: Spends resonance to copy part of the first final primary drop. Disabled by Silk Touch and block entities.
review: Four-to-sixteen extra items per activation with a one-second cooldown.

label: Mending discharge
description: Spends resonance after primary mining to restore a large amount of durability to this tool.
review: Forty-to-three-hundred-twenty durability restored; a two-second cooldown makes it a real sustain engine.

label: Shared momentum
description: Spends resonance after primary mining to grant Haste to you and nearby allied players. Works in solo play.
review: Includes its owner, so solo play benefits too; also gives long Haste I–III to nearby allies.

label: Alternating current
description: Alternating ore and stone breaks within three seconds generates resonance.
review: Three-to-sixteen charge from alternating strata rewards a deliberate mining rhythm.

label: Knowledge siphon
description: Grants mining XP directly with a milestone bonus and repairs this pickaxe. Mending Affinity multiplies the repair; native Mending adds its repair rate. No XP orbs remain for other equipment.
review: Direct XP also repairs the pickaxe, supports Mending Affinity and vanilla Mending, and gains a milestone XP bonus.

label: Apprentice resonance
description: Adds stochastically rounded extra tool XP after valid primary mining. Unpaid ascension gates still block XP. At level 100, extra XP instead grants twice as much player XP and resonance.
review: Fourfold expected extra tool XP; at mastery it converts to player XP and resonance instead of becoming a dead roll.

label: Careful mason
description: Chance not to consume the material for a successful utility placement; you must still own it.
review: Triple conservation chance with a 95% cap; a material must still be owned before placement.

label: Precision silk
description: Silk Touch chance while standing still. Shares the base harvest exclusion group.
review: Triple stationary Silk chance makes precision stance a dependable alternative.

label: Pocket press
description: Compacts plain inventory resources using their native crafting ratios after mining. Stage 0: raw metals and nuggets. Stage 1: coal, redstone, lapis. Stage 2: diamonds, emeralds, quartz, amethyst. Stage 3: netherite ingots. Batches increase with stage. Named or component-bearing inputs are excluded.
review: Basic metals work immediately; one-second cooldown and up to eight recipe batches per activation.

label: Spoils ward
description: Temporarily prevents damage to your final mined drops via the native invulnerability-check event; underlying entity flags remain unchanged.
review: Ten-to-sixty seconds of protection for owned mined drops, rather than a few seconds.

label: Choking dust
description: Primary sediment mining pulses Weakness on nearby hostile mobs. Never targets players or passive mobs.
review: Weakness I–IV over a larger radius and a four-second cooldown.

label: Pyroclastic
description: Adds furnace-recipe processing chance and up to 75% extra furnace output, plus furnace XP. Yield bonus is 25% of this effective value. Disabled by Silk Touch.
review: 2.5x processing strength; it also grants up to 75% furnace yield and substantial furnace XP beyond reliable smelting.

label: Cinder chain
description: Each successful primary furnace-processing event generates resonance. Also contributes smelting chance equal to 4% per effective point, so it can work alone.
review: Triple generation and an inherent smelting chance, so it is not inert without another furnace modifier.

label: Soul furnace
description: Pays resonance to smelt every eligible primary drop and its secondary excavation chain. Milestones add output yield and furnace XP. No player XP cost. Silk Touch still wins.
review: Pays one resonance instead of player XP and processes the whole excavation chain, with milestone yield and XP bonuses.

label: Basalt heart
description: Primary Nether stone mining repairs durability and grants Resistance.
review: Large repair plus long Resistance I/II on Nether stone.

label: Magma reservoir
description: Mining near lava generates resonance.
review: Fourfold lava-themed generation; niche location now produces substantial energy.

label: Soul cleanse
description: Mining soul sand, soul soil or Nether rock removes negative effects and grants Regeneration. Removes Poison, Wither, Slowness and Weakness in that order.
review: Also triggers on Nether rock and grants regeneration, instead of requiring a very specific soul block.

label: Piglin purse
description: Adds gold nuggets on a primary gold ore or gilded blackstone proc. Disabled by Silk Touch.
review: Triple chance and nine-to-thirty-six gold nuggets, including gilded blackstone.

label: Ghast breath
description: Spends resonance after primary mining to knock away and ignite nearby enemies. Never targets players or passive mobs.
review: Cheaper, frequent large knockback and ignition pulses for actual defense.

label: Emberlight
description: Spends resonance to create a soul torch in a dark, supported mined cell. Native placement cancellation still applies.
review: Cheaper, fast soul-torch placement supplied by the tool core.

label: Infernal echo
description: Spends resonance to break connected Nether ores, including ancient debris, with furnace processing on its secondary blocks. Crouch to enable. Shares the area budget.
review: Sixteen-to-sixty-four Nether ores with automatic furnace processing; stronger than the ordinary ore perk in its niche.

label: Chorus hop
description: Sneak-right-click air to spend resonance and blink forward. Requires a loaded, dry, collision-free destination with a solid floor. Does not teleport automatically during mining.
review: Intentional sneak-right-click phase blink, four to twelve blocks, cheaper cost and shorter cooldown.

label: Ender dispatch
description: Collects primary drops into inventory and sends overflow to the Ender Chest. Higher stages also retrieve your owned freshly mined drops at range. Full containers leave exact remainders in the world.
review: Full overflow collection at full quality immediately; later stages remotely recover owned mined drops within six-to-twenty-four blocks.

label: Repulsor
description: Primary ore mining knocks enemies away and reflects enemy-owned projectiles. Never reflects player or dispenser projectiles.
review: Larger, frequent knockback also reflects enemy-owned projectiles, while leaving player projectiles alone.

label: Entanglement
description: Refunds a fraction of resonance spent by this tool and shares the same refund with nearby allied wielders. Useful alone. Refunds never recursively trigger more refunds.
review: Refunds 25–60% of resonance spending, and shares the refund with nearby allies; useful in solo play too.

label: Temporal echo
description: Spends resonance to prime extra copied items on the next primary break within thirty seconds. A successful echo consumes the priming. Disabled by Silk Touch and block entities.
review: Cheaper priming, three-to-sixteen copied items, a one-second cooldown and a thirty-second window.

label: Shulker pulse
description: Spends resonance after primary mining to levitate nearby enemies. Never targets players or passive mobs.
review: Cheaper, frequent Levitation I/II over a larger radius and duration.

label: Endstone alchemy
description: Spends resonance after primary End Stone mining for a chance of bonus ender pearls. Disabled by Silk Touch.
review: A 35–100% pearl chance, up to three pearls, a two-second cooldown and cheaper energy.

label: Void anchor
description: Returns you from below the world to a safe same-dimension position recorded while holding this tool. Pays resonance or emergency durability if charge is insufficient. One quality roll per fall, with a milestone cooldown. Only loaded, dry, safe destinations qualify.
review: Works without a separate generator: spends charge or emergency durability; milestone cooldown improves from sixty to twenty seconds.

label: Dimensional battery
description: Directly collects your mined drops and retrieves owned freshly mined drops nearby. Successful collection in the primary mining event generates resonance once. Remote collection cannot farm charge.
review: Comes with short-range direct collection and rewards any successful inventory or Ender Chest transfer.
